description: Timestamp converter — Convert between Unix time and ISO dates: pass unix seconds, unix milliseconds or any ISO date and get unix, unixMs, ISO 8601, UTC string, day of week and a relative phrase. With no value it returns the current time. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).

value.description: optional: unix seconds, unix ms, or an ISO date (default now)

name: util_timestamp
